title: Amid Iran War Tensions, Energy Market Resilience Wears Thin
summary_en: Fresh attacks on energy infrastructure in the Middle East may push regional leaders to build the first post-U.S. security arrangement for the Strait of Hormuz. As U.S. voters head to the polls in a few weeks, an expensive war linked to affordability concerns will be top of mind.

title: The U.S.-China Summit: Too Big and Too Small to Fail
summary_en: Scott Kennedy argues that although the Trump-Xi summit will likely extend the current period of stability, the gap between the convening’s limited ambitions and the growing challenges facing the world points to a growing vacuum of global leadership.

title: Is the U.S. Banking System Ready for a Post-Quantum Future?
summary_en: Sultan Meghji argues that the hardest cryptographic deadline facing U.S. banks is being set by SWIFT and foreign supervisors, not Washington. Adversaries are harvesting encrypted financial traffic now. Three of the four fixes require no new statutory authority.
